details: The agent faithfully executed both planned tasks using the provided Python scripts, matching the specified model: MixedLM totinc ~ C(caste) + C(domhigh) + C(caste):C(domhigh) with random intercepts for village, and for Task2 additionally performed an OLS with village fixed effects and ANOVA on C(domhigh). Preprocessing (merge, filter domhigh in {0,1}, listwise deletion) followed the plan. The only deviation was a bounded implementation fix: adding scipy to dependencies to satisfy statsmodels, which is acceptable. Outputs include the mixed model coefficients and p-values, as well as the omnibus ANOVA p-value, and conclusions consistent with the computed results. No major methodological deviations from analysis_info.json were observed.
